scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with an open hand on a rocky lakeshore as disciples look toward him beside a boat and fishing nets, with blue water and hills behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus revealing himself again to his disciples at the Sea of Tiberias in John 21:1. The setting, poses, number of disciples, and visual details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven men gather in conversation beneath a tree near the water, with boats and distant hills behind them, in a warm watercolor illustration.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the seven disciples together in John 21:2; their appearances, conversation and surroundings are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At night, five men in a wooden fishing boat draw up an empty net by lamplight, with a moonlit shoreline in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 21:3, when Simon Peter and his companions go fishing and catch nothing that night.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise, Jesus stands on a rocky shore facing disciples in a wooden boat; they look toward him with questioning expressions. Fish rest over a small fire in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 21:4: morning has come, Jesus stands on the shore, and the disciples do not yet know it is him. The boat, landscape and foreground details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks from a lakeshore to fishermen in a wooden boat; one holds out an empty basket as the others look toward him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 21:5, where Jesus asks whether they have any fish and they answer no. The lakeside setting, boat, clothing and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Fishermen in a wooden boat strain to pull a net crowded with fish from the water beside them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 21:6: after the instruction to cast the net on the boat's right side, the catch is so large that they cannot haul it in.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter, wearing a secured outer garment, splashes into the sea beside a wooden boat as a disciple points toward Jesus on the distant shore.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 21:7: the disciple whom Jesus loved identifies the Lord to Peter, who puts on his outer garment and casts himself into the sea. The setting and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Several disciples in a wooden fishing boat pull a fish-filled net through the water near a sunny shore.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 21:8: the other disciples come in the boat near land, dragging the net of fish. The setting and appearances are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: People step onto a rocky lakeshore and look toward fish resting on glowing coals, with bread nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 21:9: those coming onto land see a fire of coals with fish on it and bread. The setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward three fishermen carrying freshly caught fish in a net and basket beside a boat on a sunlit lakeshore.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 21:10, where Jesus asks them to bring some of the fish they have just caught; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Simon Peter and other fishermen draw a full, unbroken net of large fish onto a rocky lakeshore in golden light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 21:11, where Simon Peter draws an untorn net containing 153 large fish to land. The setting and other fishermen are artistic details; the illustration does not establish a count.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends his hands toward disciples gathered around a breakfast of bread and fish beside a lake in the morning light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus inviting the disciples to breakfast and their quiet recognition of him as Lord in John 21:12. The setting and visual details are an artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus offers a round loaf to a seated man while holding a basket of bread and fish, surrounded by men beside a lake.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 21:13, in which Jesus takes bread and gives it to them, and likewise the fish. The lakeside setting and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with open hands among disciples gathered beneath a tree, with a lake and boats in the sunlit background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the risen Jesus revealed to his disciples, reflecting John 21:14, which identifies this as the third time. The landscape and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with Simon Peter beside the remains of a meal, while lambs rest nearby in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 21:15: after they had dined, Jesus asks Peter about his love and tells him to feed his lambs. The lambs pictured express that charge and are not stated to be physically present in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward sheep while speaking with Simon, who holds a hand to his chest, in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus asking Simon about his love and telling him to shepherd his sheep; the flock gives the command a visual form, not a claim that sheep were present.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently to a sorrowful Peter, who kneels with one hand over his heart, while sheep graze in a sunlit landscape beside the water.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes Jesus asking Peter a third time about his love, Peter's grief and response, and Jesus' charge to feed his sheep. The grazing sheep and setting are artistic choices, not details asserted by this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man stretches out his hands as another man holds his sash and guides him along a rocky path above a lakeside town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the verse's contrast between the freedom of youth and old age, when another will dress and lead the person where he does not wish to go.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures invitingly as a solemn disciple walks beside him on a rocky path above a sunlit lake, with hills and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus inviting a disciple to follow him, reflecting the verse’s words about the death by which he would glorify God. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter turns to look at a disciple following him as Jesus walks ahead along a sunlit path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Peter turning to see the disciple whom Jesus loved following. John 21:20 also recalls that this disciple had reclined against Jesus at supper and asked who was betraying him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter sits beside Jesus beneath a tree, gesturing toward a man standing nearby with a fishing net in a sunlit lakeside landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Peter seeing a man and asking Jesus what about him in John 21:21. The setting, appearance and identity of the other man are artistic choices not specified in this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to a man walking beside him on a sunlit path, while another man stands farther back near the water.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking Jesus' call to follow him and his conditional words about another man remaining until he comes; the landscape and details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures as he speaks to three attentive companions in a sunlit stone courtyard, while a younger disciple stands nearby beneath the trees.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the saying spreading among the brothers in John 21:23. The verse clarifies that Jesus spoke conditionally about the disciple remaining until he comes, rather than saying that the disciple would not die.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-haired disciple holds a reed pen over a blank scroll while two companions listen beside him in a sunlit room overlooking a distant blue landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene represents the disciple who bears witness and wrote these things, and the shared confidence that his testimony is true; the setting and companions are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An ancient writer pauses at a low desk as uncountable blank scrolls spread across the sunlit hills toward the horizon.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visual metaphor for John 21:25: the many other things Jesus did are suggested by more scrolls than the landscape can hold. The writer, setting and arrangement are artistic choices, not a claimed eyewitness portrait or additional event.
